http/http1_session#

One HTTP/1.1 client connection: one request at a time, no pipelining.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let session = Http1Session(input: tcp, output: tcp, owner: tcp);
let exchange = await session.exchange(request);
exchange.response();

Description#

One HTTP/1.1 client connection: one request at a time, no pipelining.

The connection is reused only after a response body was read to its end; a body left unread or broken closes it.

Public API#

object Http1Session#

object Http1Session does Closing

One explicit transport owner, no pipelining. Admission remains held by the response body until verified EOF. Failed/abandoned bodies discard transport.
